reviewer: Separate same-session ecosystem/economics agent; not an independent institution

findings.finding: Initial cash-profit bridge used wrong debt sign
findings.disposition: Root found during development; original source retained; final bridge uses cash plus debit-positive debt liability minus equity injections

findings.finding: Pooled shared validation was charged but not scheduled
findings.disposition: Corrected before freeze: advance capacity availability by batch validation hours

findings.finding: Negotiation implicitly read exact private buyer reservation
findings.disposition: Corrected before freeze: buyer sends bounded bid, seller applies public discount floor, buyer separately tests participation

findings.finding: Budget/capacity commitments processed random-calendar prospects in ID order
findings.disposition: Corrected before freeze: chronological prospect ordering prevents future inquiry commitments entering earlier decisions

findings.finding: Buyer benefit ignored realized delivery and failure outcomes
findings.disposition: Ex-ante assumed gain and modeled realized service benefit now separate; latter is compared with expected modeled outside utility, not an observed counterfactual

findings.finding: Renewals used coin-flip demand without participant utilities
findings.disposition: Corrected before freeze: explicit modeled renewal utility versus internal/competitor/no-action options; procurement refusal retained as terminal state

findings.finding: Runoff overhead and last lifecycle day could be omitted
findings.disposition: Corrected before freeze: runoff administration charged; last lifecycle day tracked independently of detail logging; final debt interest through operational end

findings.finding: Correction could extend deadline without updating maximum wait
findings.disposition: Corrected before freeze: final wait updated; deadline breach produces final refusal/refund

findings.finding: Unbounded emergency funding could hide capital failure
findings.disposition: Prospective fixed commitment cap added; deposits excluded; any rescue equity or residual debt explicitly flags financing failure, not a financeable success

findings.finding: Human-hours total excluded fixed research labor
findings.disposition: Explicitly labeled variable service hours; fixed research labor remains charged in startup costs

remaining_limits: Eight-hour support capacity reservation per accepted order is an aggregate conservative proxy, not a calendar-level staffing schedule or verified weekly service-level guarantee.
Supplier participation uses a fixed reservation-rate rule and quote/capacity scenarios; competitor responses are parameterized. No general equilibrium is solved.
Demand, buyer values, cost rates, conversion, acceptance and collection behavior are estimates. Primary-source wages anchor a range but do not validate a business quote or willingness to pay.
Buyer realized service benefit compares a modeled realized path with modeled expected outside utility. It is not a paired observed causal customer-benefit estimate.
The simulator represents commercial acceptance of a previously executed technical class; it does not rerun the full RTL toolchain for every simulated commercial buyer.
Technical ordinary-library parity and identical-free-library commercial stress do not measure an independent conventional enterprise's complete real project costs.
Any emergency equity is a model shortfall indicator. It is not authorized financing, actual capital, or an instruction to fund the enterprise.
The fixed campaign source uses a 180-day acquisition window and a maximum 730-day runoff bound; neither is evidence of reachable real demand.
No actual customer messages, purchases, sales, collections, fund transfers, contracts or paid commitments were made.
Renewals model utility and procurement but then assume acceptance and full collection, without a second failure/correction/warranty/default cycle.
Residual lender balances are measured at modeled terminal dates; later interest, creditor recovery, restructuring and insolvency resolution are not modeled.
